body: Today I have completed the unpacking and inventory of a lot of items, Inventory based off order list. Currently I am going on the site 1 by 1 and key punching all the information, I really need to find an automated way to do this, because this is taking a really long time. My current plan until then is to add a few peace's of merchandise daily. Any way I have a lot of big plans for the future, in the way of builds and information for the average gunpla and mecha model builders. Don't get me wrong there is a lot of really cool information out there now but I fill like it sets the bar and expectations of new builder to high. Meaning, In my case when i got into the hobby i watched some videos seen how there's came out in the end and thought, They made that look really easy. Being a mechanic I should know better because I herd it all the time _ man you sure made that look easy LOL. So i fell into the trap and build my first Gundam and thought boy the build came out fine but shit the decals are not straight and i should have never even tried panel lining yet. So I want to present builds that my customers will actually be holding in there hands after there finished. As time progress, I also want to show my progress as a builder/customizer and hope others can follow along and increase there skill as well. Any way that's my plan now have to do some accounting and statistics homework for a couple college classes I'm taking. Happy Building and until next time.
